meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先问你在做什么工作,再据此提出一套笔记分类(观察类型和概念标签),经你确认后安装并激活成 claude-mem 的自定义 mode,可选配置 Telegram 提醒,最后重启 worker 并验证启动上下文里出现该 mode。
howto.when: 当你想定制 claude-mem 记住什么、创建或修改 mode、添加观察类型或概念标签,或为某些记忆发 Telegram 通知时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个记录法律案例的 claude-mem 模式
say.note: 先问你的工作,再提分类方案

say.text: 这个模式里,每次案子确立规则都记一条
say.note: 会作为观察类型加入提议

say.text: 给这个模式的某类笔记加 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 选类型或标签后配置推送

howto.what_en: Claude asks what you work on, proposes note types and concept tags, and after you approve installs and activates it as a custom claude-mem mode; optional Telegram alerts, worker restart, and startup-context verification follow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or concept tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories.

say_en.text: Create a claude-mem mode for tracking legal case notes.
say_en.note: It first asks about your work, then proposes a taxonomy.

say_en.text: In this mode, record every time a case establishes a rule.
say_en.note: Added as an observation type in the proposal.

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts for one note type in this mode.
say_en.note: You pick types/tags, then alerts get configured.
